titles: How Long to Count to a Trillion? 🤯
Counting to 1 Trillion Takes LONGER Than History
1 Million vs 1 Billion vs 1 Trillion Seconds
description: If you counted one number every second, how long would it take to reach one trillion? 🧠
About 31,700 years. Longer than all of recorded history: you'd have to start in the Ice Age.
All numbers are approximate, nonstop, no sleep. (Saying big numbers out loud takes way more than a second, so real life is even slower!)
How far would YOU get before giving up? 👇
